metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Iris Compassback
records.biography_en: In The Slightly Lost Patrol, Iris Compassback takes the role of confused navigator. “North is looking at me.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one large clear compass held sideways, simple needle.

records.name: Hal Knotkeeper
records.biography_en: In The Slightly Lost Patrol, Hal Knotkeeper takes the role of proud knot maker. “It has a name. So do the ends.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one short thick rope tied into a clear tidy knot.

records.name: Ned Campkettle
records.biography_en: In The Slightly Lost Patrol, Ned Campkettle takes the role of patient camp cook. “It's almost tea.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small green enamel kettle with handle, no flame.

records.name: Mina Trackmark
records.biography_en: In The Slightly Lost Patrol, Mina Trackmark takes the role of alert track reader. “It came back wearing the same print.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one small clay footprint cast and short magnifier.

records.name: Perry Rainroll
records.biography_en: In The Slightly Lost Patrol, Perry Rainroll takes the role of weary kit carrier. “My bed is already packed for tomorrow.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short rolled bedroll tied with two thick bands.

records.name: Bram Badgeblank
records.biography_en: In The Slightly Lost Patrol, Bram Badgeblank takes the role of earnest badge learner. “I earned the stitching part.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: round blank patch and short thick sewing needle with rounded point.
